title: Orion
tagline: Your Web3 AI Companion! Onboard with socials, track events, trade smarter, and stay fit with AI & blockchain. Secure, seamless, and built for the future. Ready to level up? 🔥
description: Our project, Orion, is a next-generation Web3 AI companion that simplifies managing your digital life. By connecting your social accounts and Google & Gears, Orion gathers your tweets and profile data to build a dynamic, personalized profile. Using AI-driven sentiment analysis, it then offers smart recommendations for your work, events, and health. A custom plugin lets our Eliza Agent call a browser-based interface for advanced tasks, and a voice-activated holographic agent allows you to trigger transactions with simple voice commands. All transactions are secured with agentic wallets powered by Privy, giving you full control with custom spending rules.
how_its_made:
- **Agentic Wallets:** We use Privy for server wallets acting as agentic wallets for orion. Users can set spending limits and rules (custom policies).
- **Custom Eliza Plugin:** We built a special plugin for our Eliza Agent to call a browser-based web UI for advanced tasks.
- **Holographic Agent:** A voice-activated agent lets you trigger transactions with voice commands.
- **Sentiment Analysis:** Our tool scans your social/onchain data to build a dynamic character profile that fits your interests.
- **Tech Stack:** The project is built with React, Node.js, Express, and blockchain technology. AI powered by OpenAI GPT-4 creates the profiles, while state channels and custom oracles ensure fast and secure transactions.
